_what: RUCKUS (the user 9 Nov: Top Rudder's Ruckus, derived from Rufus - the story plane untouched - and brought to the real airframe): the Solo 103's sheet - span 28.4 ft (8.66 m), 122 ft2 (11.33 m2: chord 1.31 m), 17.5 ft long (the boom 4.45 -> 3.40) - and its construction as reported: a 4130 steel-tube pod, the wing fabric (Oratex) on aluminium spars, carbon tail surfaces; the Ruckus options: automatic (carbon) slats full span, the flaperon the garage has (plain inboard flaps + ailerons drooping 20 deg), Beringer brakes as single-caliper discs, 26-inch Airstreak bush wheels, the locking tailwheel, Oratex (no paint); the 80 hp Rotax 912 (Kitplanes: 80-100 hp Rotax); three tanks - the nose 9 L, both wing bays 19 L - 47 L. Garage gaps: a full-span flaperon wing, a ballistic parachute.
